name: Shiiba Gou
source:
Flaw: Extreme social anxiety

‘I can game when I get home…I can game……
Alright, I’m gonna get this job done real soon!’

Voice actor who loves to play games. He is rude and loud among his friends, but at work, he is very mature. He’s especially bad at talking to girls, and goes into a state of despair every time he fails to hold a proper conversation.
